name: The Sealed Crypt
description: a vaulted crypt, its air dead and cold
specialText: A great stone sarcophagus dominates the chamber, its lid carved with a screaming face.

name: The Goblin Warren
description: a reeking warren of filth-streaked tunnels
specialText: Crude totems of bone and hide ring a cold fire pit.

name: The Forgotten Shrine
description: a ruined shrine to a nameless god
specialText: A cracked altar glistens with old, dark stains. You feel watched.
